commit.title: thread_task: don't check if the picture still exists for progress updates
commit.message:
thread_task: don't check if the picture still exists for progress updates

The entropy and reconstruction progress updates checked whether the frame's
picture was already freed "upon flush". This can't happen: a frame's picture
is only freed when its last task is done (each running task holds a count
until after its progress update), by abort_frame() before any of its tile
tasks exist, or by dav2d_flush(), which first waits for all worker threads
to be parked (frame threading implies worker threads). The same code also
accesses f->cur.error without such a check.
